title: Firecrawl Variables
description: Configuration variables for building and serving the Firecrawl web-scraping API service.

FIRECRAWL_BUILD_DIR.description: Scratch build directory used when compiling Firecrawl workspace dependencies.

FIRECRAWL_DEST.description: Destination directory into which the Firecrawl repository is cloned or updated.

PYTHON_VENV.description: Python virtual environment path used by Firecrawl auxiliary worker processes.

BUILD_DIR.description: Fallback scratch build directory override when FIRECRAWL_BUILD_DIR is unset.
